texts: The Bone Sparrow shows us that
One kind of power in The Bone Sparrow is the physical power the Jackets hold over everyone in the camp.

edits.find: When Subhi explains the Night Sea
texts: When Beaver catches Subhi at the fence, “He shoves me backward so hard that my feet leave the ground.” This shows that the Jackets’ power is in their bodies, which makes the reader feel how small and breakable Subhi is next to them.

In the same scene, “I can’t talk. I can’t say a single thing.” This shows that physical power also takes away Subhi’s voice, which makes the reader understand that fear can silence a person before a word is said.
physical power is one kind of power in the camp: it can throw a boy against a wall, and it can stop him speaking at all.
